The Tobacconist’s Folio · 11 Entries

Cigars & the ritual around them

Prices checkedSept 24, 2026

Boxes worth laying down, honest-value bundles, and well-made tools. Every comparison is against observed street price—not an ornamental MSRP.

Availability note. Eleven entries were price-checked September 24, 2026 across Famous Smoke Shop, JR Cigar, and CigarBid. The Oliva Serie V box promotion ends October 1, 2026; the Selection 5000 bundle promotion and Crazy Alice auction lot end September 27, 2026.

Affiliate disclosure · dormant. These are plain merchant links with no affiliate tags. The Ledger does not currently receive compensation from a purchase.

Collectible ≠ guaranteed return

The investment desk is an asking-price snapshot, not a resale forecast. Each listing names its comparison source and shows condition and completeness where the scan confirmed them.

Price integrityThese two references use dealer asking prices; completed-sale data was unavailable during the scan.
LiquidityEstimate how broad the resale market is and how quickly similar pieces actually move.
CompletenessBox, papers, original parts and service records can matter disproportionately.
Ownership dragBuyer premium, tax, servicing, insurance and selling fees belong in the thesis.

Market data, not financial advice. No appreciation claims. Watches are illiquid collectibles; values can fall, provenance can be wrong, and servicing can erase an apparent discount.

Notes on the register

01 / DEAL PRICE

Merchant listing

The displayed deal price was verified on the merchant product page on September 24, 2026. Coupon, cash/wire, shipping, seller, and condition details are shown where they affect the effective price.

02 / REFERENCE

Street-price check

Reference prices come from the named comparable source. Some references use current live listings rather than completed sales because eBay’s sold-listings view was sign-in walled.

03 / OPEN QUESTIONS

Verify before buying

Availability, checkout pricing, seller terms, warranty coverage, and exact condition may change. Jomashop was intermittently blocked during the scan, although its included deals were verified before access failed.
